__comment: kDrive (Infomaniak) is TOKEN-based: the customUI app com.palm.app.kdrive-auth takes a personal API token (Drive scope) and calls verifyToken, which validates it and auto-discovers account_id + drive_id, returning credentials.common = {accessToken, accountId, driveId}. OAuth was ruled out - Infomaniak OAuth/OIDC only grants identity scopes and rejects `drive` (invalid_scope). validator.address points at verifyToken; the app derives the service URI from it. DOCUMENTS-only (no PHOTO.UPLOAD provider).
__comment2: com.palm.app.kdrive-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission).
__comment3: com.palm.service.kdrive is in read+writePermissions so the service can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops and writeCredentials back after an OAuth token refresh. Token-mode credentials are long-lived (no refresh).

capabilityProviders.__comment: The file-picker app (and the QuickOffice reroute) consume listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile. kDrive is numeric-ID based (adapter stringifies ids for consumers); the drive-root id is 1 but is non-writable - the adapter resolves it to the private-space folder.

Makes the kDrive account a photo source. implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and (via the templateId->serviceName switch in its Utils.js - see ../photos-integration/) calls com.palm.service.kdrive/listAlbums+listPhotos, then downloads bytes with the curl-patched Sync-Manager. One kDrive folder (Config.PHOTO_ALBUM_NAME, default 'Pictures', under the private-space root) is surfaced as one album; src_big/src_small carry ?access_token= (kDrive has no unauthenticated pre-signed links), so the curl -L fetch needs no auth header.
